records.title: Steer2Adapt: Dynamically Composing Steering Vectors Elicits Efficient Adaptation of LLMs
records.reason: Steer2Adapt searches a composition of activation-steering vectors and injects it at inference. The text evaluates task adaptation but does not establish reduced generation compute, memory, or serving latency; optimization/search overhead and adaptation quality need a workload-specific check.

records.title: Locas: Your Models are Principled Initializers of Locally-Supported Parametric Memories
records.reason: Locas attaches locally supported parametric memory for continual learning and reports accuracy/parameter/time tradeoffs for test-time training. It can reduce memory parameters versus some adaptation baselines, but its reported relative times include added adaptation compute and do not show cheaper ordinary LLM serving.

records.title: Classifying OSHA construction accident reports: leveraging ensemble learning and lightweight large language models (l-LLMs)
records.reason: Construction-accident classification with small encoder models and ensembles is an application benchmark, not a general LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Accurate Clinical Entity Recognition and Code Mapping of Anatomopathological Reports Using BioClinicalBERT Enhanced by Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach
records.reason: Clinical entity extraction and ontology mapping application; no LLM serving optimization.
